All Referrals - Trends & Rates
=================================================

```{r data-trends, include=FALSE}

# All Referrals - Trend
referrals <- pds %>%
  filter(demog == "none") %>%
  select(fy, geog, name, referrals)

# All Referrals - Rates per 10,000 population
referral_rates <- pds %>% 
  filter(demog == "none") %>%
  select(fy, geog, name, rate)

# All Referrals - Outcomes by Financial Year
outcomes <- pds %>%
  filter(demog == "none") %>%
  select(fy, geog, name, exp_rate, perc_met)

```

<h2 style="margin-left: 70px; margin-top: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px"> Number of Individuals Diagnosed and Referred for PDS; Scotland</h2>

```{r trend-plot}

# Static Plot Data (All Referrals)
referrals_df_scot <- SharedData$new(
  referrals %>%  
  filter(name == "scot"))

# Plot (All Referrals)
referrals_plot_scot <- plot_trend_mi(
  data = referrals_df_scot, 
  measure = referrals, 
  x ="Financial Year of Diagnosis", 
  y = "Number Referred", 
  measure_text = "Referrals: ", 
  Scotland = TRUE)

# Layout
bscols(widths = 12, div(style = css(width="98%", height="360px"), referrals_plot_scot))

```


### **Note**

<span style="color:red"> **MANAGEMENT INFORMATION: FOR LIMITED INTERNAL DISTRIBUTION AND NOT FOR PUBLIC RELEASE.** </span>

This page includes rates of the number of people referred to PDS per 10,000 population (65 years and over). Note that for financial year *`r pop_data_to`* the Mid-2023 populations are used as this is the latest available estimate. *See the [Glossary](#glossary) for more details.*

The Integration Authority Area and Health Board tabs include a chart and table showing the rate for each geographical area by financial year. 

The Trend tab includes a chart and table showing the trend of the rate by financial year for Scotland, Integration Authority Areas and Health Boards. Multiple areas can be selected.  

*The figures shown for `r provisional_year` onwards are currently provisional and subject to change in future versions of this report.*  

`r if(qt != 4) {div(style = css(fontStyle="italic"),paste0("For diagnoses in financial year ", current_fy, " data is available up to and including Q", qt, "."))}`

<br>

*See Additional Notes on [Home](#home) page for further information on data issues with specific Boards/Integration Authority Areas/Financial Years.*

### **Note**

<span style="color:red"> **MANAGEMENT INFORMATION: FOR LIMITED INTERNAL DISTRIBUTION AND NOT FOR PUBLIC RELEASE.** </span>

This page includes charts and tables showing, for the selected areas, the trend by financial year for information relating to the LDP Standard.  

The first tab shows the percentage of the estimated number of people newly diagnosed with dementia that have been referred to PDS for Scotland and Health Boards (estimates are not available for Integration Authority Areas). 

The second tab shows the percentage of referrals that have received one year’s support which started within a year of diagnosis (or have been exempt from the LDP Standard) for Scotland, Integration Authority Areas and Health Boards. 

*The figures shown for `r provisional_year` onwards are currently provisional and subject to change in future versions of this report.*  

`r if(qt != 4) {div(style = css(fontStyle="italic"),paste("LDP Standard performance figures are not provided until data is available for the full financial year."))}`

<br>

*See Additional Notes on [Home](#home) page for further information on data issues with specific Boards/Integration Authority Areas/Financial Years.*

### **Percentage of estimated diagnoses referred to PDS**

```{r dropdown-exp}

# Dynamic Plot Data (Expected Diagnosis Rates by Health Board)
exp_df <- SharedData$new(
  outcomes %>%
    filter(
      name %in% c("scot", "health_board"),
      fy %in% full_years))

# Dropdown (Health Board)
filter_exp <- filter_select(
  id = "filter_exp_trend_geog",
  label = "Select Health Board(s):",
  group = ~geog,
  sharedData = exp_df)

# Layout
bscols(widths = c(1,10,NA), NULL, filter_exp, NULL)

```

<h2 style="margin-left: 70px; margin-top: 0px; margin-bottom: 0px"> Percentage of people estimated to be newly diagnosed with dementia who were referred for PDS</h2>

```{r trend-plot-exp}

# Dynamic Plot (Expected Diagnosis Rates by Health Board)
exp_plot <- plot_trend_mi(
  data = exp_df, 
  measure = exp_rate, 
  x ="Financial Year of Diagnosis", 
  colours = phs_colours_15,
  percentage = TRUE)

# Layout
bscols(widths = 12, div(style = css(width="98%", height="360px"), exp_plot))

```

```{r trend-table-exp}

# Static Table (Expected Diagnosis Rates by Health Board)
create_trend_table_static(
  data = outcomes %>%
    filter(fy %in% full_years), 
  measure = exp_rate, 
  geog_filter = c("health_board", "scot"))

```
